response.sql:
WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT cs.constructorId, COUNT(*) as standing_count
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  GROUP BY cs.constructorId
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(standing_count) as avg_count FROM constructor_counts
)
SELECT
  c.constructorId,
  c.nationality,
  cc.standing_count,
  cc.standing_count - s.avg_count as difference_from_avg
FROM constructor_counts cc
CROSS JOIN stats s
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cc.constructorId
WHERE cc.standing_count > s.avg_count
ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only constructors with at least one standing record are counted; constructors not appearing in constructorStandings are excluded from both the count and the average calculation.
